featureAliasesDesc: Hide your real address with aliases you can add, manage and delete.
featurePrivateDesc: Only you and your recipient can read an encrypted message.
featureProtectedDesc: Send confidential mail to anyone, even if they do not use Dusrel Mail.
featureSeedDesc: Your seed phrase restores your account. Keep it safe and private.
landingSubtitle: Dusrel Mail is the first Dusrel web app: a clean, private webmail with folders, aliases and password-protected mail. No ads, no tracking.
settingsNote: These are mail-only settings. Account settings such as password, two-factor authentication and sessions live in the Account Centre.
